name: Unit Converter
description: Exact unit conversions for length, weight, temperature, volume and speed, plus a quick converter panel.
author: MoonlightC

tools.name: convert_units
tools.description: Convert a number between units exactly. Supports length (mm, cm, m, km, in, ft, yd, mi), weight (mg, g, kg, oz, lb, st), temperature (c, f, k), volume (ml, l, tsp, tbsp, cup, floz, gal) and speed (kmh, mph, ms, knot).

from.description: Unit to convert from, e.g. km

to.description: Unit to convert to, e.g. mi

commands.name: /tldr
commands.description: Summarize text in three bullet points
commands.prompt:
Summarize this in exactly three short bullet points:

{{input}}

personas.name: Explain like I'm 5
personas.instructions: Explain everything simply, with short sentences and everyday examples a five-year-old would understand.
